"RADIOLOGY REPORT" (Word version, tracked changes ON)
Saltmarsh Regional Medical Center - Diagnostic Imaging Pt: Marisol Teixeira-Brandt DOB: 03/19/2028 MRN: 5530-2271 Accession: RAD-69-447120 Exam date: 09/24/2069 Ordering: Dr. Fiona Page (Eastgate Women's Health, cc oncology) Exam: CT abd/pelvis with IV contrast
S: 41 y.o. female sent from the ER follow up clinic with rectal bleeding since August 13, weight loss, tired all the time. Hx of 2 early pregnancy losses and a pre-eclampsia pregnancy, nothing abdominal surgically.
O: Compared to nothing, no prior CT in our sytem. Thickened wall of the rectosigmoid colon about 4 cm long with stranding around it. Mutliple low density lesions both lobes of liver, largest 3.1 cm in segment 7. Small lymph nodes along the mesentery. No free fluid. Uterus is normal size, IUD not seen (pt is on a ring, see chart) [Comment by Jenna Kowalczyk, MA: pt told me the ring ended in 2069, pls check]. Lungs bases clear. Kidneys fine.
A: Rectosigmoid mass with liver metastases, tumor spread until proven otherwise. Looks like possible Lynch syndrome type pattern? Not our call. Not Crohn's.
P: Recommend colonoscopy w/ biopsy and call to Tomasz Varga today. Called to office 09/24/2069 at 15:40, spoke with front desk.
In conclusion, the CT scan of Marisol tells a story of a young woman's journey, which is a heavy one, and the radiology team hopes this page helps her care team move quickly. Pt was super chill in the scanner, no vibes of anxiety.
